BiblicalUsage: Ezekiel was set on a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south. The word is the building itself, and the prophet's vision begins with a structure he cannot yet name.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the frame of the city is a promise in outline: Ezekiel saw the building before he saw its measurements, and God shows the shape before He fills it.
